summary: Official interactive, fillable Judicial Council of California form FW-001 (Request to Waive Court Fees), allowing low-income litigants or public benefit recipients to programmatically declare financial eligibility for fee waivers.
full_text:
Request to Waive Court Fees
FW-001
Judicial Council of California, courts.ca.gov

If you are getting public benefits, are a low-income person, or do not have enough income to pay for your household's basic needs and your court fees, you may use this form to ask the court to waive your court fees.

1. Personal Information
2. Employment details
3. Legal representation
4. Court identification
5. Eligibility criteria (public benefits, household income limits, or financial hardship)
6. Prior requests
7. Income fluctuations
8. Gross monthly income source details
9. Household size and member income
10. Property and assets declaration
11. Monthly expenses and deductions
